t: 法尔萨卢斯之战:朱利叶斯·凯撒在法尔萨卢斯决定性地击败了庞培,庞培逃到埃及.
te: Battle of Pharsalus: Julius Caesar decisively defeats Pompey at Pharsalus and Pompey flees to Egypt.
dz: 凯撒内战:法尔萨卢斯之战:朱利叶斯·凯撒在法尔萨卢斯决定性地击败了庞培,庞培逃到埃及.
de: Caesar's Civil War: Battle of Pharsalus: Julius Caesar decisively defeats Pompey at Pharsalus and Pompey flees to Egypt.

t: 庞贝一到埃及就从佩卢西姆上岸,然后被波勒米十三世国王下令暗杀.
te: Pompey disembarks at Pelusium upon arriving in Egypt, whereupon he is assassinated by order of King Ptolemy XIII.

t: 尤利乌斯·凯撒抵达托勒密埃及追捕庞培，并得知后者已死。
te: Julius Caesar arrives in Ptolemaic Egypt in his pursuit of Pompey and learns of the latter's death.
